requirements.0: Generate a unique short code per long URL.
requirements.1: Redirect short → long with very low latency.
requirements.2: Handle a very high read:write ratio (reads ≫ writes).
requirements.3: Optional analytics, expiry and custom aliases.
requirements.4: Async click analytics that never adds latency to redirects; at-least-once event delivery.
requirements.5: Abuse controls: destination allowlist/HTTPS, rate limits on create, malware URL denylist hooks.

0.name: API service
0.role: Validates input, creates or looks up mappings.

1.name: Key generation
1.role: Base62 of an auto-increment id or hash, collision-checked.

2.name: KV store / DB
2.role: code → long-URL mapping, sharded by code.

5.name: ID allocator
5.role: Snowflake/range-reserved counters → Base62; avoids central hot lock per request.

6.name: Redis cache
6.role: code → destination (+ expiry); TTL ≤ link expiry; negative-cache 404 briefly.

7.name: Links DB
7.role: Sharded primary for mappings; unique(code), unique(alias) where present.

8.name: Analytics bus
8.role: Kafka/Pulsar topic for redirect events; workers aggregate offline.

tradeoffs.1: Hashing (stateless, collisions) vs counter+Base62 (coordination, no collisions).
tradeoffs.2: A read-through cache adds complexity but is essential at this read ratio.
tradeoffs.3: Global single table vs shard-by-code-prefix (scale vs cross-shard admin queries).
tradeoffs.4: Strong uniqueness on alias (correct) vs eventual uniqueness (faster writes, repair jobs).

lld.dataModel: Link(code PRIMARY KEY, destination, owner_id, created_at, expires_at). A unique index on code arbitrates alias collisions. Cache entries carry a TTL bounded by link expiry.
lld.api: POST /links accepts a destination and optional alias, returning the code. GET /:code resolves it and returns a redirect. Invalid URLs return 400; alias collisions return 409; expired or missing links return 404.
lld.execution: Validate HTTP/HTTPS destinations, allocate a Base62 code, insert with a uniqueness constraint and retry collisions. Reads consult the cache, then the durable store, then populate the cache. Emit analytics asynchronously after the redirect decision.
lld.failures: Cache loss falls back to the database with bounded concurrency. Expired links never outlive their cache TTL. Rate limits and destination validation constrain abusive writes; asynchronous analytics must not delay redirects.

requirements.0: Limit N requests per window per key (user / IP / API key).
requirements.1: Low latency with a clear fail-open or fail-closed policy.
requirements.2: Work across many app servers consistently.
requirements.4: Configurable fail-open vs fail-closed per route class when the store is unavailable.
requirements.5: Observability: allow/deny rates, hot keys, and shadow mode for policy rollouts.

0.name: Limiter middleware
0.role: Checks and decrements quota before handling.

1.name: Counter store (Redis)
1.role: Atomic counters/tokens keyed by client + window.

2.name: Algorithm
2.role: Token bucket, sliding-window log or fixed window.

4.name: Lua / atomic op
4.role: Refill + consume in one round-trip; avoids race between GET/SET.

5.name: Local shedder
5.role: Optional process-local token cache for fail-open soft limits.

6.name: Metrics
6.role: Export allow/deny, latency, and Redis errors for SLO burn alerts.

7.name: Admin API
7.role: CRUD policies, purge keys, and emergency global brakes.

tradeoffs.0: Fixed window (cheap, boundary bursts) vs sliding window (accurate, costlier).
tradeoffs.1: Token bucket allows bursts; leaky bucket smooths output.
tradeoffs.2: Local in-memory (fast, per-node) vs centralized (consistent, network hop).
tradeoffs.3: Fail-open (availability) vs fail-closed (cost/security) when Redis times out.
tradeoffs.4: Sync check on every request vs async/optimistic + reconcile (risk of overshoot).

lld.dataModel: Bucket(key, tokens, last_refill_ms, capacity, refill_rate). Store expiring keys in Redis. Derive the key from the authenticated principal or a trusted proxy's client address.
lld.api: check(key, cost, now) returns allowed, remaining and retry_after. Middleware returns HTTP 429 and Retry-After when quota is exhausted. Costs and policy are server controlled.
lld.execution: Use one atomic Redis operation to refill up to capacity, test request cost, consume tokens and update the timestamp. Use a shared clock policy; clamp negative elapsed time. Expire idle buckets to bound storage.
lld.pseudocode:
function allow(key, cost, now):
  bucket = loadOrCreate(key)
  bucket.tokens = min(capacity, bucket.tokens + elapsed(bucket, now) * refillRate)
  if bucket.tokens < cost: return reject(retryAfter(bucket))
  bucket.tokens -= cost
  saveAtomically(bucket)
  return allow

lld.dataModel: Job(id, idempotency_key UNIQUE, payload_ref, run_at, priority, attempts, lease_owner, lease_until, status). Keep large payloads in object storage and transitions in a durable record.
lld.api: POST /jobs enqueues idempotently; GET /jobs/:id reads status; POST /jobs/:id/cancel requests cooperative cancellation. Workers claim a lease, heartbeat it and acknowledge completion with their lease token.
lld.execution: The scheduler moves due jobs to a ready queue. A worker atomically leases a job, performs an idempotent side effect, then acknowledges. Retry transient failures with exponential backoff and jitter; exhausted jobs enter a dead-letter queue.
lld.failures: Worker crashes release work after lease expiry. Fencing tokens prevent an expired worker from acknowledging a reassigned job. Duplicate deliveries are expected, so business effects need their own idempotency boundary.

tradeoffs.3: Sync ack to agent after Kafka (durability) vs after index (higher latency).

lld.dataModel: Event(event_id, tenant_id, timestamp, service, severity, trace_id, body). Partition the ingest stream by tenant and service, and index time-bounded shards. Store compressed originals in object storage.
lld.api: POST /events accepts bounded batches with event IDs. GET /search takes a tenant, time range, query and cursor. GET /aggregations returns bounded time buckets. Every query is scoped to the caller's tenant.
lld.execution: Collectors batch and compress events. The broker durably buffers them; consumers validate schemas, redact configured fields and bulk-index documents. Commit offsets only after durable processing; event IDs deduplicate replays.

for batch in broker.consume():
  events = validateAndRedact(batch)
  unique = discardKnownEventIds(events)
  index.bulkWrite(unique)
  archive.write(unique)
  broker.commit(batch.offset)

  signature = fingerprint(normalized)

tradeoffs.0: Event-based (compact for sparse activity) vs sampled.
tradeoffs.1: Bigger blocks compress better but slow random access.
tradeoffs.2: Shared global dictionary (ratio) vs per-chunk (parallelism, simpler recovery).
tradeoffs.3: Sync index publish with seal (readers never see holes) vs async (higher write FPS).
tradeoffs.4: Single-file layout (simple) vs multi-file shards (parallel dump from many scopes).

lld.dataModel: Signal dictionary maps IDs to widths and types. Independently compressed chunks contain a time range, an initial state snapshot, delta timestamps, value changes and a checksum. A sparse index maps time ranges to file offsets.
lld.api: append(signal_id, time, value) records a transition; flush() seals a chunk; read(signals, start, end) seeks to the nearest snapshot and replays deltas. The reader validates format version and checksums.
lld.execution: Capture only transitions, encode timestamp deltas, pack repeated values and compress bounded chunks. Publish index entries after chunk durability. Random access loads one starting snapshot and only the necessary subsequent blocks.
lld.failures: Recover a partially written file by scanning committed chunks. Preserve all four-state digital values and same-time ordering. Test round-trip equality; compression ratios and seek latency depend on workload and chunk size.

maestro.tagline: A Cadence multi-agent system that helps engineers resolve simulation tickets end-to-end — with people in control at the high-risk steps.
maestro.summary: MAESTRO is a Cadence multi-agent platform for engineering-ticket resolution on Xcelium workflows. It coordinates specialist AI agents under human oversight so tickets move from triage toward a verified fix with clearer handoffs and less repeated context-gathering. Measured on an internal evaluation set, it cut ticket-resolution time by 45% and root-cause-analysis time by 55%. Built with team Mindsmiths for the Cadence AI Buildathon 2026 and selected for trade-secret protection — implementation details stay internal.
maestro.problem: Simulator tickets often bounce across R&D, validation and documentation. Context lives in many places, handoffs re-gather the same evidence, and under pressure important steps get skipped while backlog items age.
maestro.challenge: Coordinate agent assistance across a ticket’s lifecycle without giving up engineer control, without inventing unsupported conclusions, and without publishing proprietary workflow internals.

approach.0: Framed the product as orchestration plus human gates: agents propose and gather evidence; engineers approve risky transitions.
approach.1: Optimized for grounded answers — conclusions tied to retrieved engineering evidence rather than free-form speculation.
approach.2: Designed for everyday IDE use so the assistive flow meets engineers where they already work.
approach.3: Measured outcomes on an internal ticket sample and treated the system as proprietary Cadence IP after Buildathon recognition.

xcelium-ai-agents.summary: Cadence ChipStack AI कृते एकं बहु-अभिकर्तृ-LLM-तन्त्रं यत् Xcelium SystemVerilog-अनुकरणानि प्रोफाइल् करोति, रन्टाइम्-स्मृति-बाधाः निदानयति, संशोधनानि च अनुशंसति, प्रयुनक्ति, सत्यापयति — कम्पाइलर्-फ्लैग्स्, RTL-पुनर्लेखनानि, अपशिष्ट-सङ्ग्रहण-स्मृति-समायोजनं च — एकस्मात् अन्तःक्रियात्मक-टर्मिनल्-UI तः। अस्मिन् कार्यक्षमता-अभिकर्ता, स्मृति-अभिकर्ता, सहभाजिता कार्यप्रवाह-रूपरेखा, प्रतिगमन-रूपरेखा च अन्तर्भवन्ति: ~37K Python-पङ्क्तयः 650+ परीक्षणानि च।
xcelium-ai-agents.problem: अनुकरणस्य कार्यक्षमता-स्मृति-कार्यं विशेषज्ञ-निर्भरम्: अभियन्तारः प्रोफाइलर्-निर्गमं पठन्ति, हॉट्स्पॉट्-स्थानानि RTL सह सम्बध्नन्ति, फ्लैग्स् पुनर्लेखनानि वा चिन्वन्ति, ततः पुनः चालयित्वा तुलयन्ति। प्रारम्भिकानि अभिकर्तृ-संस्करणानि प्रत्येकं यान्त्रिकसोपानं LLM-उपकरण-आह्वानैः नयन्ति स्म, येन तानि मन्दानि अभवन् — प्रतिवेदनानि च ताः सङ्ख्याः उद्धर्तुं शक्तानि अभवन् याः विश्लेषकः कदापि न उत्पादितवान्।
xcelium-ai-agents.challenge: एतादृशान् अभिकर्तॄन् निर्मातुं ये प्रोफाइलर्-दत्तांशात् सत्यापित-संशोधनपर्यन्तं हस्तसोपानं विना गच्छन्ति, तथापि शीघ्राः, विश्लिष्ट-दत्तांशे आधारिताः, सत्रान्तरेषु पुनरारम्भणीयाः, परीक्षणीयाः च तिष्ठन्ति — यद्यपि द्वे चालने अपि समाने न भवतः।

approach.0: 8-अभिकर्तृ-कार्यक्षमता-पाइपलाइन् निर्मितवान् — स्वीकारः, योजना, समानान्तरं कम्पाइलर्-फ्लैग्-लेखापरीक्षणं / हार्डवेयर्-समूहनं / प्रतिरूप-निष्कर्षणम्, 3-स्तरीयं RTL-पुनर्लेखनम्, प्रयोगः, ततः पुनश्चालनं तुलना च।
approach.1: स्मृति-अभिकर्तारं निर्मितवान्: heap-प्रतिच्छायाः call-stack-प्रोफाइलिङ्गं च, शिखर-अभिज्ञानम्, C++ demangling-सहितं सहभाजित-पुस्तकालय-आरोपणम्, RTL-सञ्चिका-पङ्क्ति-उद्धरणानि, पूर्व/पश्चात्-तुलनासहिताः अपशिष्ट-सङ्ग्रहण-प्रयोगाः च।
approach.2: उभौ अभिकर्तारौ निश्चितता-प्रथम-रीत्या पुनः संरचितवान्: स्वीकारः, अनुकरण-चालनानि, प्रोफाइल्-विश्लेषणं च LLM-उपकरण-चक्रेभ्यः बहिः Python मध्ये स्थानान्तरितानि, मॉडलं तु तर्कार्थं विकल्पार्थं (fallback) च रक्षितम्।
approach.3: OpenAI Agents SDK उपरि सहभाजितां रूपरेखां संरचितवान्: अभिकर्तृ-नोड्-समूहस्य ग्राफ्-आधारितं समन्वयनम्, checkpoint/resume-सहिता schema-संस्करणीकृता अवस्था, कठोराः संरचित-निर्गमाः, विकृत-JSON-तः पुनःप्राप्तिः, प्रति-नोड् fallback-मार्गनिर्धारणं च।
approach.4: प्रतिवेदन-सङ्ख्याः Python मध्ये निर्माय प्रतिवेदक-अभिकर्तृभ्यः किमपि उपकरणं न दत्त्वा मिथ्या-कल्पित-सङ्ख्याः निवारितवान्, येन प्रत्येका सङ्ख्या विश्लिष्ट-प्रोफाइल्-दत्तांशं प्रति अनुसर्तुं शक्यते।
approach.5: अवधारणा-प्रमाण-रूपां प्रतिगमन-रूपरेखां अभिकल्पितवान् या pseudo-terminal द्वारा वास्तविकं टर्मिनल्-UI चालयति: प्रतिपरीक्षणम् एका YAML-प्रविष्टिः, एकः परीक्षणसूची-आधारितः LLM-निर्णायकः च यः प्रत्येकं प्रतिवेदनं समीक्षित-golden सह तुलयति।

regression-triage.title: Xcelium प्रतिगमन-वर्गीकरण-रीगोल्ड-प्रणाली
regression-triage.tagline: ~16K-पङ्क्तीनां प्रणाली या सहस्रशः प्रतिगमन-विफलताः सुरक्षितेषु सत्यापितेषु कार्येषु परिवर्तयति — रीगोल्ड्, छन्नी, छूटः अथवा उन्नयनम्।
regression-triage.summary: अनुकारक-परिवर्तनानन्तरं प्रतिगमन-अभियानानि शतशः सहस्रशः वा विफल-परीक्षण/विधि-संयोजनानि प्रत्यर्पयन्ति, प्रत्येकस्य च निर्णयः आवश्यकः। इयं ~16K-पङ्क्तीनां प्रणाली नियमाधारित-श्रेणीकरणेन, TF-IDF-समूहनेन, ऐतिहासिक-अधिगमेन, वैकल्पिक-LLM-समीक्षया च वर्गीकरणं, रीगोल्ड्, छूटाः, सत्यापनं च स्वचालयति। अनया 79 चालनेषु 2,120 विफलताः संसाधिताः — तासु 73% अन्य-अभियन्तृभिः कृतेषु चालनेषु।
regression-triage.problem: प्रत्येकं विफल-परीक्षणम् अनेकेषु कार्येषु एकम् अपेक्षते: golden-सञ्चिकायाः नवीकरणम्, diff-छन्नी-योजनम्, उपेक्षा छूटः वा, कार्यक्षेत्र-सुधारः, उन्नयनं वा। प्रमाणं प्रतिचालनं परिवर्तते (स्थान-सङ्केताः, PID-सङ्ख्याः, कालमुद्राः, पथाः), एकं मूलकारणं दशशः प्रायः-समानाः विफलताः उत्पादयति, एकः अशुद्धः रीगोल्ड् च परीक्षण-समूहं वास्तविकदोषं प्रति मौनेन अन्धं करोति।
regression-triage.challenge: निर्णयं सुरक्षितरूपेण स्वचालयितुम्: चालनेषु समानं दोषम् अभिज्ञातुम्, भङ्गः उपकरण-त्रुटिः वा नूतनं golden कदापि न भवेत् इति सुनिश्चितुम्, भिन्न-golden-सञ्चिकाभिः सह तुलयतः विधीन् निर्वोढुम्, प्रत्येकं परिवर्तनं प्रतिविधि सत्यापयितुम्, अतीत-अभियानेभ्यः शिक्षितुं च — पुनरारम्भणीयं प्रत्यावर्तनीयं च तिष्ठन्।

approach.0: प्रतिगमन-रात्रिकालीन-विफलतासूचीः परीक्षण-, बैंक्-, विधि-समूहेषु मानकीकृतवान्, ततः प्रतिसञ्चिका-तालकैः, dry-run, पुनरारम्भ, प्रत्यावर्तन-सुविधाभिः सह प्रत्येकं विधिं समानान्तरं पुनः चालितवान्।
approach.1: स्थान-सङ्केतान्, सङ्ख्याः, पथान्, PID-सङ्ख्याः, कालमुद्राः च आवृत्य प्रमाणं चालन-स्थिर-हस्ताक्षरेषु मानकरूपेण परिणमितवान्, येन एकस्य दोषस्य पुनरावृत्तयः एकाम् एव अङ्गुलिमुद्रां सहभजन्ते।
approach.2: नियमैः, नूतन-चालनेषु भारित-मतदानेन, रक्षित-मानव-संशोधनैः च प्रत्येकां विफलतां श्रेणीकृतवान्, ततः TF-IDF-एन संचयात्मक-समूहनेन च समान-विफलताः समूहीकृतवान्।
approach.3: वर्गानुसारं निस्तारणं द्वारबद्धं कृतवान्: केवलं diff-वर्गीयाः विफलताः एव golden-सञ्चिकां प्राप्तुं शक्नुवन्ति — भङ्गाः, काल-सीमातिक्रमाः, उपकरण-त्रुटयः च सर्वदा मूलकारणविश्लेषणं प्रति गच्छन्ति।
approach.4: प्रतिविधि-पुनश्चालनेन प्रत्येकं रीगोल्ड् सत्यापितवान्, यत्र च रीगोल्ड् उचितम् उत्तरं नासीत् तत्र diff-छन्नीः, IGNORE-सञ्चिकाः, छूटान् वा उत्पादितवान्।
approach.5: वैकल्पिकां LLM-समीक्षां (JEDAI) योजितवान् या प्रत्येकं diff लम्बित-सङ्केत-परिवर्तनेन सह परीक्षते, येषां परीक्षणानां रीगोल्ड् न कर्तव्यं तानि चिह्नयति च — केवलं परामर्शात्मिका, सा द्वारं कदापि शिथिलं कर्तुं न शक्नोति।

perforce-replay.title: क्रॉस्-स्ट्रीम् Perforce पुनःप्रयोगः
perforce-replay.tagline: एकेन आदेशेन बहु-परिवर्तनसूची-संशोधनं कस्मिन्नपि प्रकाशन-स्ट्रीम्-मध्ये नयतु — केवलं तानि पथानि समन्वीयन्ते यानि ताः सूच्यः स्पृशन्ति।
perforce-replay.summary: विकास-स्ट्रीम्-उपरि कृतं संशोधनं प्रायः प्रत्येकस्मिन् समर्थित-प्रकाशन-स्ट्रीम्-मध्ये पुनः कर्तव्यं भवति, प्रायशः अनेकाभिः परिवर्तनसूचीभिः — मूल-परिवर्तनं, तस्य रीगोल्ड्-कार्याणि, नूतनं परीक्षणं च। इदम् उपकरणं प्रत्येकस्याः परिवर्तनसूच्याः स्रोत-स्ट्रीम् निर्धारयति, ताः सूच्यः यानि पथानि स्पृशन्ति केवलं तानि चयनात्मकरूपेण समन्वययति, ताः क्रमेण विलीनयति, काः सञ्चिकाः अद्यापि हस्तसमाधानम् अपेक्षन्ते इति यथावत् सूचयति च — एवं Xcelium-प्रकाशन-शाखासु बहु-CL-बैकपोर्ट्-कार्याणि स्वचालयति।
perforce-replay.problem: बैकपोर्ट्-कार्याणि हस्तेन, एकैकां परिवर्तनसूचीं, हस्त-सज्जित-कार्यक्षेत्रेषु क्रियन्ते स्म। आंशिक-क्लाइण्ट्-दृश्यैः अनुपस्थिताः पथाः एकैकया विफलतया प्रकटाः भवन्ति स्म, पूर्ण-समन्वयनम् अतीव व्ययसाध्यम् आसीत्, प्रत्येकस्याः परिवर्तनसूच्याः मूल-स्ट्रीम् प्रायः अज्ञातम् आसीत्, स्वतः-समाधानं च एकां समष्टि-स्थितिं सूचयति स्म या ताः सञ्चिकाः आवृणोत् याः तेन विलीनयितुम् अस्वीकृताः।
perforce-replay.challenge: प्रत्येकं प्रचालकं (operand) परिवर्तनसूची-मेटाडेटातः निर्धारयितुम् — मूल-स्ट्रीम्, कार्यक्षेत्रे के पथाः अवश्यं भवेयुः, विलय-क्रमः च — येन अभियन्ता केवलं परिवर्तनसूची-सङ्ख्याः एकां लक्ष्य-शाखां च ददाति।

approach.0: प्रत्येकस्याः परिवर्तनसूच्याः स्रोत-स्ट्रीम् तस्याः सञ्चिकाभ्यः अभिज्ञातवान्, येन एकस्मिन् चालने भिन्न-स्ट्रीम्-परिवर्तनसूच्यः मिश्रयितुं शक्यन्ते, विलयात् पूर्वं च तत् मानचित्रं मुद्रितवान्।
approach.1: सम्पूर्ण-वृक्षस्य समन्वयनस्य स्थाने, ताः परिवर्तनसूच्यः याः सञ्चिकाः निर्देशिकाः च स्पृशन्ति ताभ्यः एव समन्वयन-योजनां निर्मितवान्।
approach.2: कार्यक्षेत्र-दोषान् स्वतः सुधारितवान् — दृश्य-बाह्य-पथेभ्यः क्लाइण्ट्-दृश्यं विस्तार्य अधिलिखित-लेख्य-सञ्चिकाः पुनः प्राप्य च — ततः पुनः प्रयत्नं कृतवान्।
approach.3: परिवर्तनसूचीः आरोहण-क्रमेण विलीनितवान्, प्रत्येकां स्वस्मात् स्ट्रीम्-तः स्वस्मिन् संस्करणे, येन काचित् अपि विफलता यथार्थतः एकाम् एव परिवर्तनसूचीं निर्दिशति।
approach.4: अन्ते एकम् एव स्वतः-समाधानं चालितवान्, अस्वीकृत-सञ्चिकाः च हस्तसमाधानार्थं सूचीकृतवान्; किमपि कदापि स्वतः न प्रस्तूयते।
approach.5: वैकल्पिकरूपेण केवल-परियोजना-विन्यास-समन्वितम् एकं त्याज्यं लक्ष्य-कार्यक्षेत्रं निर्मितवान्, तस्य विघटन-आदेशं च सूचितवान्।

xcelium-optimization.title: Xcelium Logic Simulator — प्रदर्शनकलाकौशलम्
xcelium-optimization.tagline: बृहत्कार्यभारेषु मापनीयं प्रवाहोन्नतिं ददत् निम्नस्तरीयं अनुकूलनकार्यम्।
xcelium-optimization.summary: A multi-quarter performance engineering effort on Cadence's Xcelium logic simulator, focused on profiling-driven optimization, RTL transformations and structured diagnostics for production customer workloads.
xcelium-optimization.problem: Customer designs of increasing scale stress simulator throughput. Even small inefficiencies in hot paths compound across millions of simulation events, costing engineering hours and infrastructure.
xcelium-optimization.challenge: Identify high-leverage bottlenecks across an industrial simulation engine, reason rigorously about runtime behavior, and ship low-risk C++ changes that move the needle on production workloads.

approach.0: Built a reusable C++ performance-analysis library enabling Top-N profiling and structured diagnostics, presented at Cadence India Conference.
approach.1: Used Valgrind, AddressSanitizer and runtime profilers to isolate hotspots in critical simulation paths.
approach.2: Implemented RTL transformations in the Xform Engine that reshape designs into more simulator-friendly forms.
approach.3: Validated improvements against designs from Apple, Google, Samsung and NVIDIA on representative workloads.

algolens.title: AlgoLens — अन्तःक्रियात्मकं DSA-मञ्चम्
algolens.tagline: अन्तःक्रियात्मकं वातावरणं यत्र गणनाविधयः निरीक्षणीयाः, पुनश्चालनीयाः, बोधगम्याः च भवन्ति।
algolens.summary: AlgoLens is an interactive algorithm visualizer supporting 60+ algorithms with real-time step-through, deterministic replay, FFmpeg-WASM export, GenAI explanations and rich search.
algolens.problem: Algorithm learning resources tend to be static. Understanding behavior under different inputs, replaying state and exporting visuals for teaching are awkward at best.
algolens.challenge: Build a fluid, accessible, GPU-friendly visualization engine that handles 60+ algorithms with a unified step model, deterministic replay, video export and AI-assisted understanding — held to product-grade quality bars.

approach.0: Designed a step-based execution model with deterministic replay across all algorithms.
approach.1: Built Canvas-based renderers with smooth, reduced-motion-aware animations.
approach.2: Integrated FFmpeg-WASM for in-browser video export of execution traces.
approach.3: Layered GenAI for natural-language explanations and complexity analysis.
approach.4: Implemented exact, fuzzy, phonetic and semantic search for algorithm discovery.
approach.5: Hardened with WCAG 2.1 AA, Sentry, Web Vitals, Playwright, Storybook, Percy and CI quality gates.

postureiq.title: PostureIQ — वास्तविकसमये ML-अङ्गभङ्गिमाविश्लेषणम्
postureiq.tagline: 60 FPS सङ्गणकदर्शन-प्रशिक्षणप्रणाली या नियतप्रतिपोषणचक्रैः व्यायामस्य रूपं मूल्याङ्कयति।
postureiq.summary: PostureIQ is an ML-powered posture and form-coaching system built around real-time pose estimation, temporal smoothing, confidence gating and rep-quality scoring for exercise feedback.
postureiq.problem: Exercise-form feedback is usually delayed, subjective or dependent on a trainer being present. A useful assistant needs to infer pose continuously and provide clear feedback without jitter or false positives.
postureiq.challenge: Maintain real-time capture, inference and rendering while making noisy pose landmarks stable enough for actionable coaching and automated quality scoring.

approach.0: Built a deterministic capture-to-infer-to-render loop with OpenCV and MediaPipe/BlazePose.
approach.1: Added temporal smoothing, Kalman filtering, confidence gating, adaptive thresholds and 3D landmark checks to reduce noisy corrections.
approach.2: Implemented rep-quality scoring around ROM, tempo and symmetry with audio/visual feedback cues.
approach.3: Instrumented FPS, latency and error telemetry with dashboards for repeatable performance analysis.
approach.4: Added pytest coverage, golden traces and a CLI for reproducible validation runs.

track-person-app.title: Track Person App — गत्यनुगमनं दृश्यीकरणं च
track-person-app.tagline: व्यक्तेः स्थानमार्गान् सङ्गृह्य दर्शयितुं React Native-गत्यनुगमनानुप्रयोगः।
track-person-app.summary: A mobile-first tracking and visualization project that stores movement events in MongoDB and renders location history for inspection.
track-person-app.problem: Movement data is hard to reason about from raw coordinates alone; users need a visual trail and a clean data model for location events.
track-person-app.challenge: Design a lightweight mobile interface and persistence model that can capture, store and replay movement history without turning the app into a heavyweight GIS tool.

approach.0: Built the mobile surface in React Native around a simple capture and replay workflow.
approach.1: Modeled location samples in MongoDB for flexible movement-history queries.
approach.2: Added visualization views for scanning movement paths and spot-checking recorded sessions.

smart-brain.title: Smart Brain — मुखाभिज्ञान-अनुप्रयोगः
smart-brain.tagline: Clarifai-अनुमानम् Express/React-उत्पादपृष्ठेन सह संयोजयन् पूर्णस्तरः मुखाभिज्ञान-अनुप्रयोगः।
smart-brain.summary: Smart Brain is a full-stack application that sends image URLs to Clarifai, receives face-detection predictions and renders bounding boxes in a React interface.
smart-brain.problem: Computer-vision APIs are powerful but abstract; a useful learning project needs to make the request/response loop visible and interactive.
smart-brain.challenge: Integrate a third-party ML API with a clean backend boundary while keeping the frontend responsive and easy to understand.

approach.0: Built an Express API layer for Clarifai requests and response normalization.
approach.1: Created React UI flows for image submission, prediction rendering and result feedback.
approach.2: Modeled the app so API integration details remain isolated from the presentation layer.

tezos-premier-league.title: Tezos Premier League — विकेन्द्रीकृतक्रीडा
tezos-premier-league.summary: A blockchain-based PvP gaming project and NFT marketplace on the Tezos network. The work was selected for a $10,000 award to support continued development.
tezos-premier-league.problem: Designing engaging on-chain gaming experiences while keeping the user experience approachable on a non-EVM ecosystem.
tezos-premier-league.challenge: Translate game mechanics into Tezos primitives and deliver a usable frontend that hides chain complexity from players.

approach.0: Designed product flows around bracket-style gameplay.
approach.1: Built a React frontend integrating with Tezos infrastructure, Taquito and SmartPy contracts.
approach.2: Used Pinata/IPFS for NFT metadata and added safer key-handling flows around wallet interactions.
approach.3: Added rate-limited RPC handling and resilient contract-call patterns for a smoother player experience.
approach.4: Iterated on UX based on player feedback from early access.
